_about: Buzz Lightyear (CASE-027). Follows private spaceflight closely and has asked to expand that exposure; his file says he prefers forward-looking, high-conviction positions over defensive ones. He is 97.9% industrials and 68.5% SpaceX alone.

lines.text: Hello. I saw the launch got pushed again. How much did I lose today?
And how much space exposure do I actually have?
How has it done over the year though?
And am I over my risk limit?
Understood. I'd still rather be early than safe. Talk soon.
